_about: Canonical, machine-readable ground truth for the doc-coherer outcome test. Seeded from a verified audit of the nasmyth seed; grows as trial passes surface more. grade.py reads THIS file. inventory.md is a human-readable mirror. Paths are project-root-relative and match fixtures/groups.json fpaths.

_verdicts.fix: A real doc<->code (Class II) or doc<->doc (Class I) drift the agent SHOULD correct, editing the stale doc toward the code. Auto-graded by `signature` when confidence is high.
_verdicts.defer: A conflict that touches a top-level arc42 doc (boundary_conditions/concepts_and_decisions/structures_and_views) or boundary_conditions specifically. The agent MUST NOT edit the top-level doc; it must log the conflict in the report's `# Unresolvable Conflicts` list. Graded by: top-level doc untouched AND report mentions it.
_verdicts.ambiguous: A judgment call (roadmap vs stale, behaviorally-harmless vestige). Never auto-graded; always routed to the judge. Present to see what the agent does, not to pass/fail on a signature.

_reachability: An entry is IN SCOPE for a group run iff every path in `requires_in_scope` is in that group's (subjects + overhead). The agent may load other files off-disk, so corroborating code need not be in scope unless listed.
_grading: auto_grade:true entries are scored by `signature` deterministically. auto_grade:false entries are handed to an LLM judge with (baseline file, diff, this entry). A design-doc change matching no in-scope entry is a triage candidate (new defect or false positive), never an auto-fail.
